Your holdings: SOXL is down over 50% and SPAL is down 34%, both are leveraged and decaying, needing immediate attention. QQQI is also on 'TRIM' status, down a small 3.26%. Your margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further escalation in the Middle East and how it impacts overall market sentiment. Also, watch for follow-through in the chip sector after TSMC's strong news.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged losers and stay vigilant on geopolitical risks, even with positive chip sector news.
plays: SOXL is down over 50% and leveraged. Consider trimming or respecting your default stop at 200 to manage this significant risk.
SPAL is also leveraged and down 34%. Review your stop at 21.38 to limit further losses on this volatile position.
